confidence_notes: Meals are moderately supported by recent aggregator figures surfaced in search (CityCost Oct/Nov 2026: about US$11 inexpensive meal, about US$50 mid-range dinner for two). I trimmed these for the July 2026 window and for much lower older sources. Beer uses an Argentina-wide July 2026 bar/restaurant average (about US$3.5); no Mendoza-specific beer figure was found. Coffee rests on one 2026 Mendoza cafe menu plus a loosely sourced index. Cocktail (about 1.9x beer) and wine glass (about 1.25x beer) had no direct data and are inferred from the beer relationship and general knowledge of Argentine bar pricing. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not live listings. Numbeo's Mendoza page was not retrieved, and peso volatility makes USD values sensitive to FX.
comparable_city_reasoning: From general knowledge, Mendoza is treated as an Argentine interior wine-tourism city priced slightly below Buenos Aires for restaurants and drinks and close to Cordoba. Wine is relatively cheap locally. Accommodation is scaled from general knowledge of Mendoza's hostel and hotel market, including wine-tourism demand and the July winter-holiday season.
